nativeSourceContext.scope: Five Java Dockerfile startup instructions and narrowly selected production application paths relevant to the 11 dated baseline CVEs. Advisory prerequisites are referenced from the existing research, not independently refreshed here. This is not the final patched-image inventory.

startup.observation: All five share pinned Temurin 25 JRE Noble, supported apt upgrade with new dependencies/no removals, build-time system appuser creation and sh exec java startup; JAVA_OPTS defaults blank. The source instructions do not launch the named daemons or a GNU tar operation.
startup.limitation: Resolved image contents, actual processes, configured JAVA_OPTS/native agents and inherited JDK/JNI/shared-library paths were not inspected.

boundedSearch.interpretation: No matches for these tokens in the explicit production source roots. This is not proof of absent native consumers, dependency behavior or image tools.

evidence.observation: Portrait input is size-limited (default 5 MiB, configurable), type-limited and checked for 40 million pixels using registered ImageIO readers. The dimension precheck calls reader.setInput(input, true, true): seekForwardOnly=true and ignoreMetadata=true before getWidth/getHeight. Necessary format/header/provider parsing is distinct from the optional metadata this setting requests to ignore. Subsequent Thumbnailator decode explicitly enables useExifOrientation(true), then resizes and writes JPEG.
evidence.limitation: Registered ImageIO provider/JDK/JNI behavior and libpng linkage were not inspected, including header handling and subsequent full decode/EXIF orientation. Existing byte/pixel/ignoreMetadata controls are recorded; no advisory-specific native sequence or decoder wall deadline is established by this source review.

evidence.observation: Shared school image/PDF/workbook work has two nonblocking admission slots.
evidence.limitation: A concurrency cap is not a per-parser timeout or cancellation guarantee; this budget was not observed in operations image validation.

evidence.observation: POI WorkbookFactory accepts bounded XLS/XLSX data. XLSX preflight applies inflate ratio 0.01, 20 MiB entry, 10 MiB text, 100 ZIP entries and 30 MiB total expanded content; workbook/sheet/row/column/cell and formula restrictions follow.
evidence.limitation: This establishes Java ZIP/OOXML parsing, not a native expat call. Dependency parser/provider implementations and parser CPU wall bounds were not verified.

evidence.observation: Attachment validation caps data at 5 MiB by default and 10 MiB absolutely, uses fixed Java NOFOLLOW_LINKS input opening, then ImageIO or OpenPDF parsing with the school admission budget. ImageIO reader.setInput(input, true, true) requests seek-forward-only input and ignored optional metadata before the 40 million pixel check and reader.read(0).
evidence.limitation: Java fixed open options are not an attacker-provided C fopen mode. JDK/dependency native opens, media providers and pre-structural-check parser work remain unresolved.

evidence.observation: Quotation input is capped at 5 MiB. ImageIO reader.setInput(input, true, true) requests seek-forward-only input and ignored optional metadata before the 20 million pixel check and reader.read(0). OpenPDF parsing precedes 1-200 page/no-encryption/no-script and structural depth/object/action restrictions.
evidence.limitation: No per-decoder wall deadline or school shared admission budget was observed in this validator. These restrictions do not establish native parser reachability or CPU safety.

evidence.observation: Exports use Java ZipOutputStream/Deflater.NO_COMPRESSION and POI SXSSFWorkbook(100), including compressed temporary files and workbook font styling. Filename regexes are fixed literals.
evidence.limitation: JDK/POI compressed output is a candidate dependency chain, not proof of nonblocking native gzwrite followed by formatted gzip output. Font styling is document metadata; Java2D/font/JNI loading remains unverified.

evidence.observation: Examined identifier/filename checks use fixed java.util.regex patterns, including a bounded 10-200 character Drive identifier.
evidence.limitation: These specific Java patterns are not demonstrated PCRE2 DFA/JIT consumers. Native libraries or dependency calls elsewhere were not ruled out.

evidence.observation: Declared dependencies include Thumbnailator 0.4.21, POI 5.5.1, TwelveMonkeys WebP ImageIO provider, OpenPDF, Google Cloud Storage and the gRPC BOM.
evidence.limitation: No resolved native dependency inventory, selected provider implementation, JDK native library linkage or loaded-library observation was collected.
